lines.text: Isaiah tells the mortally ill Hezekiah to put his house in order, and Hezekiah prays, weeping bitterly.
Isaiah is sent back from the middle courtyard to tell Hezekiah he will go up to the LORD's house.
The LORD promises to add twenty years to Hezekiah's life and to deliver the city from the king of Assyria.
Isaiah has a poultice of myrrh applied to the boil, and Hezekiah recovers after asking for a sign.
Hezekiah chooses the shadow going back ten steps, and the LORD brings it back on the stairway of Ahaz.
